panels.title: Execution
panels.description:
The picked Run (Newest Live Run by default), at its newest second, whatever the Range. Green well, amber needs a look, red trading at risk, grey nothing to judge; a time plain.

- **Mode**: LIVE (real orders on Bitget) or PAPER (the program trades against its own copy of the books; nothing is sent): a Run is one mode, and every panel shows the picked Run only, so paper and live are never merged.
- **Run**: up for how long; starting (no sample yet); stale (no sample for more than 10 s and no stop recorded); lost (none for a minute: crashed or killed); stopped (in order).
- **Start / End**: when the Run started; for a stopped one, when it stopped; UTC+8.
- **Phase**: the US market phase, worded and coloured as on Combo Spread: Pre‑Mkt, Regular, After‑Hrs, Overnight, Closed (weekend or holiday); the program enters outside Regular only.
- **Books**: ok, or a leg whose book conflicts (snapshot and ticks disagree) or is unusable (too old or thin): no entry goes out on it.
- **Orders**: the Run's orders not final: n working, n unknown (being queried), or n left open by a stopped Run.
- **Entry**: the program's answer this second: ready (no signal yet) or order sent; the strategy's ordinary answers in grey (regular hours, spacing, quota used up, ...); held (waits on a book, F, the venue or a stop); stop (a person is needed).

                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel),
     r AS (SELECT * FROM sel), sr AS (SELECT * FROM sel),
     s AS (SELECT * FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND s.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND s.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)
           AND s.ts_ms > (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel) - 172800000 ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1),
     i AS (SELECT * FROM trade.inventory_sample i WHERE i.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND i.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND i.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)
           AND i.ts_ms > (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel) - 172800000 ORDER BY i.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1)

       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL THEN 'no run' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL AND (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms < 60000 THEN 'starting'
            WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL OR (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms > 60000 THEN 'lost'
            WHEN (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms > 10000 THEN 'stale · ' || CASE WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 1000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 's' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END
            ELSE 'up ' || CASE WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END END AS "Run",
       CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') ELSE to_char(to_timestamp((r.started_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') END AS "Start / End",
       CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped' WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data'
            ELSE CASE CASE WHEN s.phase IN ('regular', 'close_window') THEN 'Regular' WHEN s.session_end_ms IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (
  SELECT CASE WHEN s.ts_ms >= q.sc AND s.ts_ms < q.sc + 14400000 THEN 'After-Hours'
              WHEN q.t >= q.d - 1 + time '20:00' AND q.t < q.d + time '04:00' THEN 'Overnight'
              WHEN q.t >= q.d + time '04:00' AND q.t < q.d + time '09:30' THEN 'Pre-Market' ELSE 'Closed' END
  FROM (SELECT coalesce((SELECT min((a.detail ->> 'minute_ms')::bigint) + 60000 FROM trade.anchor_fact a
                         WHERE a.live = s.live AND a.session_id = s.session_id AND a.kind = 'bell'),
                        (extract(epoch FROM (s.session_id::date + time '16:00') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') * 1000)::bigint) AS sc,
               (to_timestamp(s.session_end_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS d,
               to_timestamp(s.ts_ms / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS t) q) END WHEN 'Pre-Market' THEN 'Pre‑Mkt' WHEN 'Regular' THEN 'Regular' WHEN 'After-Hours' THEN 'After‑Hrs' WHEN 'Overnight' THEN 'Overnight' WHEN 'Closed' THEN 'Closed' ELSE 'no data' END END AS "Phase",
       CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped' WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' ELSE coalesce(nullif(concat_ws(' · ',
            CASE WHEN s.conflict_bull THEN '$bull conflict' WHEN NOT s.depth_ok_bull THEN '$bull unusable' END,
            CASE WHEN s.conflict_bear THEN '$bear conflict' WHEN NOT s.depth_ok_bear THEN '$bear unusable' END), ''), 'ok') END AS "Books",
       (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'none open' WHEN NOT (SELECT sel.stopped_ms IS NULL FROM sel) THEN count(*) || ' left open'
                    WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.unknown) > 0 THEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.unknown) || ' unknown'
                    ELSE count(*) || ' working' END
        FROM trade.cex_order o WHERE o.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND o.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (o.unknown OR o.status IN ('pending', 'acked'))) AS "Orders",
       CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped' WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' ELSE CASE WHEN s.idle_reason IS NULL THEN 'order sent' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'no_signal' THEN 'ready' WHEN up' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'zero_sigma' THEN 'σ zero' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'positions_read' THEN 'reading positions' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'await_orders' THEN 'orders in flight' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'await_depth' THEN 'awaiting book' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'await_close' THEN 'awaiting flat' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'action_window' THEN 'dividend window' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'capital_pending' THEN 'capital pending' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'no_levels' THEN 'held · book thin' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'depth_bull' THEN 'held · $bull depth' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'depth_bear' THEN 'held · $bear depth' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'conflict_bull' THEN 'held · $bull conflict' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'conflict_bear' THEN 'held · $bear conflict' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'fx_stale' THEN 'held · F stale' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'rejected_backoff' THEN 'held · backing off' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'no_anchor' THEN 'held · no anchor' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'depth' THEN 'held · exit depth' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'no_price' THEN 'held · mismatch' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'pair_bound' THEN 'pairing · beyond bound' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'window' THEN 'pairing · window over' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'stop_d' THEN 'pairing · spread stop' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'profit' THEN 'pairing · profit close' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'exit_bound' THEN 'exit · beyond break-even' WHEN s.idle_reason = 'd1_loss' THEN 'exit · below break-even' WHEN panels.title: Account
panels.description:
The venue's side of the Run at its newest inventory sample (every 10 s). The program takes no decision from these (PRD 6.6); the board's own lines colour them.

- **Position**: the open round trip's side and how long it has been open; flat (the venue holds nothing on either leg); residual (amber): what the venue still holds per leg with no round trip open (dust); left open (red): a stopped Run's.
- **Ledger**: match (the venue's positions equal the program's ledger), mismatch (no orders until a person checks) or not read.
- **Equity**: Bitget usdtEquity of the WHOLE account, USDT (it also holds the sibling repository's positions); paper: none.
- **Maint. Margin**: the account's maintenance margin, USDT: margin ratio × equity.
- **Margin Ratio**: Bitget mgnRatio of the whole account (maintenance margin ÷ equity): ok below 30 %, warn below 60 %, high from there.
- **Liquidation**: the nearer leg's liquidation price from its mark, in % of the mark: ok beyond 25 %, warn beyond 10 %, near within; flat without a position; prices in Inventory.
- **Funding**: booked to the Run's round trips, USDT (+ received), or the settlements still without a record (n awaited).

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel),
     r AS (SELECT * FROM sel), sr AS (SELECT * FROM sel),
     s AS (SELECT * FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND s.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND s.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)
           AND s.ts_ms > (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel) - 172800000 ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1),
     i AS (SELECT * FROM trade.inventory_sample i WHERE i.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND i.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND i.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)
           AND i.ts_ms > (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel) - 172800000 ORDER BY i.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1), h AS (SELECT sum(l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) AS q_bull,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bull * (l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) / l.entry_qty_bull END) AS v_bull,
             sum(l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) AS q_bear,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bear > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bear * (l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) / l.entry_qty_bear END) AS v_bear,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.entry_fee_bull * (l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) / l.entry_qty_bull ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bear > 0 THEN l.entry_fee_bear * (l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) / l.entry_qty_bear ELSE 0 END) AS fee,
             max(c.direction) AS dir, min(c.opened_ms) AS opened_ms
      FROM trade.cycle c JOIN trade.lot l ON l.live = c.live AND l.cycle_id = c.cycle_id
      WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND c.status = 'open' AND l.status IN ('building', 'open')), lq AS (SELECT x.leg, x.d FROM i CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  ('$bull', CASE WHEN i.pos_bull < 0 THEN (i.liq_bull - i.mark_bull) / nullif(i.mark_bull, 0) WHEN i.pos_bull > 0 THEN (i.mark_bull - i.liq_bull) / nullif(i.mark_bull, 0) END),
  ('$bear', CASE WHEN i.pos_bear < 0 THEN (i.liq_bear - i.mark_bear) / nullif(i.mark_bear, 0) WHEN i.pos_bear > 0 THEN (i.mark_bear - i.liq_bear) / nullif(i.mark_bear, 0) END)) x(leg, d)
  WHERE x.d IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.d LIMIT 1)
SELECT CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN h.dir IS NOT NULL AND r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN h.dir || ' left open'
            WHEN h.dir IS NOT NULL THEN h.dir || ' · ' || CASE WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm' WHEN (least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad((((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE ((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad((((least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, r.end_ms) - h.opened_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END
            WHEN i.ts_ms IS NULL OR i.pos_bull IS NULL OR i.pos_bear IS NULL THEN 'no data'
            WHEN i.pos_bull = 0 AND i.pos_bear = 0 THEN 'flat'
            ELSE 'residual · ' || concat_ws(' ', CASE WHEN i.pos_bull <> 0 THEN '$bull ' || CASE WHEN i.pos_bull > 0 THEN '+' WHEN i.pos_bull < 0 THEN '−' ELSE '' END || trim_scale(abs(i.pos_bull))::text END, CASE WHEN i.pos_bear <> 0 THEN '$bear ' || CASE WHEN i.pos_bear > 0 THEN '+' WHEN i.pos_bear < 0 THEN '−' ELSE '' END || trim_scale(abs(i.pos_bear))::text END) END AS "Position",
       CASE WHEN i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN i.mismatch THEN 'mismatch' WHEN i.pos_bull IS NULL OR i.pos_bear IS NULL THEN 'not read'
            ELSE 'match' END AS "Ledger",
       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL OR i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN NOT r.live THEN 'paper' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN i.equity IS NULL THEN 'no data' ELSE to_char(i.equity, 'FM999,999,990.00') || ' U' END AS "Equity",
       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL OR i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN NOT r.live THEN 'paper' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN i.equity IS NULL OR i.margin_ratio IS NULL THEN 'no data' ELSE to_char(i.margin_ratio * i.equity, 'FM999,999,990.00') || ' U' END AS "Maint. Margin",
       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL OR i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN NOT r.live THEN 'paper' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN i.margin_ratio IS NULL THEN 'no data'
            ELSE CASE WHEN i.margin_ratio < 0.3 THEN 'ok' WHEN i.margin_ratio < 0.6 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'high' END
                 || ' · ' || to_char(100 * i.margin_ratio, 'FM990.00') || ' %' END AS "Margin Ratio",
       CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL OR i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN 'no data' WHEN NOT r.live THEN 'paper' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'stopped'
            WHEN coalesce(i.pos_bull, 0) = 0 AND coalesce(i.pos_bear, 0) = 0 THEN 'flat' WHEN lq.d IS NULL THEN 'no data'
            ELSE CASE WHEN lq.d < 0.1 THEN 'near' WHEN lq.d < 0.25 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END
                 || ' · ' || lq.leg || ' ' || to_char(100 * lq.d, 'FM999,990') || ' %' END AS "Liquidation",
       (SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(c.funding_awaited) > 0) > 0
                    THEN sum(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(c.funding_awaited) ELSE 0 END) || ' awaited'
                    ELSE CASE WHEN coalesce(sum(c.funding) FILTER (WHERE c.funding_known), 0) < 0 THEN '−' ELSE '+' END || to_char(abs(coalesce(sum(c.funding) FILTER (WHERE c.funding_known), 0)), 'FM999,999,990.00') || ' U' END
        FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL))) AS "Funding"
FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN r ON true LEFT JOIN s ON true LEFT JOIN i ON true LEFT JOIN h ON true LEFT JOIN lq ON true

panels.title: Market · Prices
panels.description:
The Run's newest second (its age: the Run tile above), as Combo Spread's Prices · Latest Second; whatever the Range.

- **${bull} Price · USDT**: Each leg's mid on the program's book, USDT.
- **${bull} Anchor · USD**: Each leg's anchor, USD per share: the bell (F × Binance's index at the close), then the issuer's NAV once confirmed.
- **Anchor**: As Combo Spread's Anchor Status: NAV, Bell (provisional, grey) or Missing (amber: no entries).
- **F · USD/USDT**: USD per USDT (Coinbase USDT-USD), the rate the program converts with: a price in USDT × F is in USD; an anchor in USD ÷ F is in USDT (owner item 80; Combo Spread's USD/USDT).

panels.title: Market · Real Spread and Signal
panels.description:
The same second, as Combo Spread's Spread and Signal · Latest Second; every spread figure in bps.

- **Real Spread · Long**: Owner item 80: the spread at both legs' pricing levels buying both (where a Long enters and a Short exits), in spread bps: 10⁴ × (F × (P_bull ÷ A_bull + P_bear ÷ A_bear) − 2), the two legs' deviations added, as Combo Spread writes it (1 bps of spread is 0.5 bps of the two legs' notional); owner item 84: blue with · Entry when it is at or past its entry line (Mean − entry_in σ); — while a leg's book conflicts or its depth is unusable (owner item 70).
- **Real Spread · Short**: Selling both (where a Short enters and a Long exits): orange with · Entry at or past Mean + entry_in σ.
- **Mean**: The program's mean of the spread (on the mids), bps (a minus sign, as in the real spreads).
- **Volatility (σ)**: Volatility (σ): the standard deviation of the spread, bps.
- **Deviation**: Spread on the mids − Mean, in bps and in σ.
- **Signal**: In Combo Spread's words, on the program's executable deviations: Long (Buy Both at or past −entry_in σ), Short (Sell Both at or past +entry_in σ), None inside; No Anchor, No Mean (σ not ready), No Book (a leg's book conflicts or its depth is unusable: the program enters on none).

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description:
What stopped or held trading in the picked Run and what became of it: the unfinished first, each group newest first, at most 200.

- **Severity**: critical: position mismatch, a lost or stale Run, an entry held for a person (settings, records, mismatch), a program error (Refused in a Row among them); serious: a sample gap, one leg only, a forced exit, an order rejected, unknown, never arrived or not found; warning: an entry held back (a book, F, no anchor, backing off, a stop pending), a stop or session end while holding, dust, funding awaited, an order not sent.
- **Status**: Open: a person is needed; In Progress: the program is still on it (only while the Run runs, else Open); Recovered: it ended by itself; Recorded: dust, recorded and not processed (owner item 47).
- **Time**: when it happened, UTC+8; for an entry held back, the start of its newest episode.
- **Source**: the part it belongs to: the Run, the positions, the entry, an order or a round trip (click a round trip's Source for its orders below).
- **What, Detail**: what happened, and its figures: for an entry held back, how often, how long in all and at most, and the seconds an executable deviation was past an entry line meanwhile (the entries it cost); a run of orders rejected in a row (same round trip, leg, purpose, side, quantity and code) is one row, Orders Rejected, with how many and from when to when, and a round trip's repeated forced-exit decisions one Forced Exit row (4.5).
- **Refused in a Row**: the program's alarm (critical, Open; again every stop_alarm_after while the refusals go on, one row with how often it was raised): Source names the leg; Detail how many orders in a row and for how long, by purpose and by error code, the last order and the venue's, the ledger's and the round trip's position (check the quantity against the venue's position).

panels.title: Summary
panels.description:
The Run's round trips closed in the Range (row title), in the owner's order (item 76); money in USDT (U), Notional and Peak Used in USDT.

- **PnL**: Gross − Fee + Funding of the round trips closed in the Range, USDT: what the strategy earned (one whose funding is not known yet left out until it is).
- **Gross**: Both legs' fills, sells less buys, before costs.
- **Fee**: Trading fees paid, a cost shown as a positive amount (as everywhere on this board: Orders, the chart markers).
- **Funding**: Funding booked to them; + received.
- **Open PnL**: The open round trip at the newest second's mids after its entry fees, before exit fees and the half spread an exit pays; green above zero, red below; not in PnL.
- **Notional**: Traded: both legs' fills (entries, completions, trims, exits) of those round trips, USDT.
- **Peak Used**: The most of N = M × L in use in the Range (held at entry prices, open orders, dust), USDT, from the Run's inventory samples.
- **Win Rate**: Closed round trips with a positive PnL.
- **Return**: PnL over Peak Used, bps (owner item 69: a return on the largest notional actually used).

panels.title: Parameters
panels.description:
The Run's settings (process_run.config) that its results are read with (owner item 80): its signal; its size and execution in the strip below, the rest in Settings.

- **Mean Model**: The mean of the spread: EMA or SMA, over its scale in minutes.
- **Volatility Scale**: The window of Volatility (σ), the spread's standard deviation, in minutes.
- **Entry**: entry_in (d_in before PRD 4.0): a Long enters when Buy Both is entry_in σ below the mean, a Short when Sell Both is entry_in σ above it; in spread bps at the newest second's σ.
- **Exit 1**: entry_out (d_out before): a Long exits when Sell Both reaches −entry_out σ from the mean (past it, on the other side, when it is negative), a Short the mirror; with Exit 2 set this line closes half the position (the round must be in profit), else all of it; in spread bps at the newest second's σ.
- **Exit 2**: exit2: the line that closes the rest, even below break-even (PRD 9.2); none: one exit line only.

panels.title: Size and Execution
panels.description:
How much the Run may hold and how it executes a batch (process_run.config inventory and exec); — where it sends both legs together.

- **Capital M**: The real capital the Run may use, USDT.
- **Leverage L**: The total leverage.
- **Notional N**: M × L: the notional the Run may hold, USDT.
- **Thin Leg**: exec.thin_leg (4.4): the leg an entry batch and a line exit batch send first, alone (core/SPEC.md 12.4, 12.7); the other leg follows by the first one's fills; both together: the way before (a Run before PRD 4.0).
- **Pair Window**: pair_window: how long the other leg is chased after the thin leg's first fill; then the part not paired is unwound.
- **Pair Stop**: pair_stop_d, spread bps: the ideally paired spread this much worse than at the decision ends the chase (entry) or closes the exit's other leg whatever its break-even (exit).
- **Top‑Up Max**: thin_topup_max: top-ups of the thin leg, while the spread goes on widening, keep its fills within this many times its planned quantity.
- **Exit Window**: exit_pair_window: how long an exit's other leg waits for its break-even bound before it closes whatever the price.

panels.title: Position · ct and USDT
panels.description:
The Run's newest second (a stopped Run's last), whatever the Range.

- **Side**: Flat, or the open round trip's side: Long (both legs bought, blue), Short (both sold, orange).
- **${bull} · ct**: Contracts held on the leg as the program counts them, signed (+ long, − short); – when flat.
- **Cost · USDT**: USDT: what the held contracts cost at entry, both legs (the notional held).
- **Held**: Time since the round trip opened.
- **To Exit 1**: σ still to go to the (first) exit line (a Long: Sell Both up to −entry_out σ; a Short: Buy Both down to +entry_out σ); 0 or less: at the line · –: a leg's depth is unusable (the program sends no exit then; a book conflict does not stop an exit).
- **To Exit 2**: The same to the second line (exit2), which closes the rest; – without it.

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms

rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel),
     r AS (SELECT * FROM sel), sr AS (SELECT * FROM sel),
     s AS (SELECT * FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND s.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND s.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)
           AND s.ts_ms > (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel) - 172800000 ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1),
     i AS (SELECT * FROM trade.inventory_sample i WHERE i.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND i.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND i.ts_ms <= (SELECT sel.end_ms FROM sel)

             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bull * (l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) / l.entry_qty_bull END) AS v_bull,
             sum(l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) AS q_bear,

panels.title: Spread · bps
panels.description:
After Combo Spread's Spread chart (owner item 81), in spread bps: 10⁴ × (F × (P_bull ÷ A_bull + P_bear ÷ A_bear) − 2), the two legs' deviations added (1 bps of spread is 0.5 bps of the two legs' notional), on the time picker's axis.

- **Real Long Spread**: buying both legs at their pricing levels (blue): a Long enters when it falls to Mean − entry_in σ (blue dashed), a Short exits when it falls to Mean + entry_out σ (orange dotted); thick where it is at or past its entry line (owner item 84).
- **Real Short Spread**: selling both (orange): a Short enters when it rises to Mean + entry_in σ (orange dashed), a Long exits when it rises to Mean − entry_out σ (blue dotted); thick at or past its entry line.
- **Mean**: the program's mean of the spread on the mids.
- **Volatility lines**: Mean ± 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 and 3 σ, grey, whole multiples dashed and halves dotted, stronger further out, as Combo Spread draws them (owner item 84); the Run's entry and exit lines in colour over them.
- **Markers**: Markers (owner items 81, 84; 4.4): a long entry a green triangle ▲, a short entry a red triangle ▼; a failed entry (the thin leg filled nothing; with both legs together no fill) a grey triangle; an unwound entry (a leg filled and was closed back: at a profit or at the stop) an amber triangle; an exit a circle in the colour of the position it closes (closing a Long green, closing a Short red; a forced exit too, its tooltip says Forced); at the decision's executable spread. Hover one for its Execution ID (the round trip's opening, UTC+8, owner item 83: every marker of one round trip has the same, as its row in Round Trips), the action, each leg's filled contracts and average price, what was trimmed back or unwound, the notional, the fees paid (a cost, positive) and the round trip's PnL. A marker counts its whole step: an entry every order of its batch (with the thin leg first the thin order, its top-ups, the other leg's pairing orders and the unwinds), an exit its orders and those of its other leg, so an exit whose legs were closed by separate orders shows both; a leg it sent no order on shows —. With the thin leg first an entry also shows how its batch ended and why, the other leg's pair cap P*, the ideally paired spread and how long the pairing took; an exit its stage (Exit 1 the half, Exit 2 the rest), its pre-check (failed: it exits below break-even all the same, a loss accepted), how its other leg closed (within break-even, or a hard close at the window or the spread stop) and the round's net expected at the decision against the net after the batch: their difference is what the execution cost.
- **Points and marks**: Points: every second up to 25 min, then 5, 10, 30 s and whole minutes (a real spread is its bucket's extreme on its entry side, of the seconds whose books the program enters on: none, and tooltip Book Not OK, where a leg's book conflicts or its depth is unusable, owner item 70); a gap: no sample (process down), or a new session or run; shaded: each round trip from entry to exit (blue Long, orange Short; its mark under the chart: times, end reason, PnL); purple marks: a change of the anchors in use, with reason and both legs' anchors before → after (owner item 62).

WITH RECURSIVE sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms

rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel), x0 AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN r <= 1000 THEN 1000 WHEN r <= 5000 THEN 5000 WHEN r <= 10000 THEN 10000 WHEN r <= 30000 THEN 30000 ELSE ceil(r / 60000) * 60000 END::bigint FROM (SELECT ($__to - $__from) / 1500.0 AS r) x) AS step),
b AS (
  SELECT max(s.ts_ms) AS ts, s.run_id, s.session_id,
         (array_agg(s.mid_d ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC))[1] AS mid, (array_agg(s.mu_d ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC))[1] AS mu,
         (array_agg(s.sigma_d ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC))[1] AS sigma,
         min(CASE WHEN (s.stats_ready AND s.depth_ok_bull AND s.depth_ok_bear AND NOT (s.conflict_bull OR s.conflict_bear)) THEN s.mu_d + s.x_long_d END) AS rl, max(CASE WHEN (s.stats_ready AND s.depth_ok_bull AND s.depth_ok_bear AND NOT (s.conflict_bull OR s.conflict_bear)) THEN s.mu_d + s.x_short_d END) AS rs,
         min(CASE WHEN (s.stats_ready AND s.depth_ok_bull AND s.depth_ok_bear AND NOT (s.conflict_bull OR s.conflict_bear)) THEN s.x_long_d END) AS xl, max(CASE WHEN (s.stats_ready AND s.depth_ok_bull AND s.depth_ok_bear AND NOT (s.conflict_bull OR s.conflict_bear)) THEN s.x_short_d END) AS xs,

panels.title: Deviation · bps
panels.description:
After Combo Spread's Deviation chart (owner item 81): the Spread chart with its Mean at zero, in spread bps; no line on the mids (owner item 84).

- **Real Long Deviation, Real Short Deviation**: the real spreads − Mean (blue, orange): a Long enters when blue falls to −entry_in σ (blue dashed) and exits when orange rises to −entry_out σ (blue dotted); a Short the mirror (orange lines); thick at or past the entry line.
- **Volatility lines**: ± 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 and 3 σ, grey, as on the Spread chart.
- **Markers**: Markers (owner items 81, 84; 4.4): a long entry a green triangle ▲, a short entry a red triangle ▼; a failed entry (the thin leg filled nothing; with both legs together no fill) a grey triangle; an unwound entry (a leg filled and was closed back: at a profit or at the stop) an amber triangle; an exit a circle in the colour of the position it closes (closing a Long green, closing a Short red; a forced exit too, its tooltip says Forced); at the decision's executable deviation. Hover one for its Execution ID (the round trip's opening, UTC+8, owner item 83: every marker of one round trip has the same, as its row in Round Trips), the action, each leg's filled contracts and average price, what was trimmed back or unwound, the notional, the fees paid (a cost, positive) and the round trip's PnL. A marker counts its whole step: an entry every order of its batch (with the thin leg first the thin order, its top-ups, the other leg's pairing orders and the unwinds), an exit its orders and those of its other leg, so an exit whose legs were closed by separate orders shows both; a leg it sent no order on shows —. With the thin leg first an entry also shows how its batch ended and why, the other leg's pair cap P*, the ideally paired spread and how long the pairing took; an exit its stage (Exit 1 the half, Exit 2 the rest), its pre-check (failed: it exits below break-even all the same, a loss accepted), how its other leg closed (within break-even, or a hard close at the window or the spread stop) and the round's net expected at the decision against the net after the batch: their difference is what the execution cost.
- **Points and marks**: Points: every second up to 25 min, then 5, 10, 30 s and whole minutes (a real spread is its bucket's extreme on its entry side, of the seconds whose books the program enters on: none, and tooltip Book Not OK, where a leg's book conflicts or its depth is unusable, owner item 70); a gap: no sample (process down), or a new session or run; shaded: each round trip from entry to exit (blue Long, orange Short; its mark under the chart: times, end reason, PnL); purple marks: a change of the anchors in use, with reason and both legs' anchors before → after (owner item 62).

panels.title: Round Trips · Newest First
panels.description:
Every round trip of the Run open at any time in the Range, newest first, at most 500; no-fill ones (nothing traded) left out.

- **Execution ID**: the round trip's opening (its first entry), UTC+8 (owner item 83): every marker of the round trip on the Spread and Deviation charts (entries, completions, trims, exits) shows the same ID; click for its orders below.
- **Closed, Held**: its close, and open to close (to now while open).
- **Side**: Long: both legs bought; Short: both sold.
- **Notional**: both legs' entry value, USDT (a One Leg round trip: that leg's).
- **In σ**: the executable deviation at its entries, weighted by their value.
- **Out σ**: at the exit decision (– for a forced exit or none).
- **Net**: Gross − Fees + Funding, USDT; Open while open, Pending (amber) while a funding settlement it held through has no record.
- **Net bps**: Net ÷ Notional × 10⁴ (bps of the notional, not of the spread).
- **End Reason**: why it closed; Nothing Paired (4.4): the thin leg first and every batch unwound (the program's one_leg).

panels.title: Batches · ct, USDT and s
panels.description:
The entry batches of the picked round trip, in their order (4.4, core/SPEC.md 12.4: with the thin leg first one batch sends the thin leg alone, pairs it with the other leg, and ends in one of five states).

- **End**: Built, Built Partial (part paired, the rest of the thin leg unwound or closed at a profit), Unwound at a Profit or at the Stop (nothing paired), Entry Failed (the thin leg filled nothing), Pairing Now; with both legs together Built, Unwound: One Leg Trimmed Back, No Fill.
- **Why**: what ended the pairing: Pair Window Over, Ideal Spread Stop, Too Small to Pair, Thin Leg Closed at a Profit, Program Stopping, Forced Exit; empty when the other leg paired it all.
- **$bull ct, $bear ct**: the contracts the batch opened on each leg (the thin order, its top-ups, the other leg's pairing orders).
- **Back ct**: what was closed back (unwinds and profit closes of the thin leg's unpaired part; with both legs together trims).
- **Pairing s**: from the thin leg's first fill to the end of the pairing, seconds.
- **Net USDT**: the batch's own net (its lot's): of an unwound batch what the unwind or profit close made; Open while it holds a position (its exits are the round trip's).

panels.title: Orders · ct, USDT and ms
panels.description:
The picked round trip's orders (the Range's newest by default), in the order the program sent them, its fills folded in. Every order with a fill has its own row; a run of consecutive orders without a fill, refused (Rejected) or cancelled (No Fill), on the same leg, purpose, step, side and quantity and with the same error code is one row (4.5): the whole run is in the folded row Every Order below. Status comes right after Side here, so that what happened to a run is in view at 1280 px.

- **Time, Until**: when the order was sent, ms, UTC+8; for a run of orders the first and (Until) the last one's time.
- **Orders**: how many orders the row stands for: 1, or the number in the run.
- **Step**: what the order was for, from the decision that sent it (4.4; it replaces 4.3's Purpose column, which stays in the panel's data): Batch n · Thin Leg or Top-Up (purpose entry), Pair (complete: the other leg pairing the thin leg's fills), Unwind or Profit Close (trim: the thin leg's unpaired part closed back), n the entry batch of the round trip; Exit 1 · Thin, Exit 1 · Thick, Exit 2 · Hard Close (the thick leg closed whatever its break-even); with both legs together Batch n · Entry, Complete (the leg that filled less), Trim (the leg that filled more), Exit, Forced.
- **Side**: Buy or Sell; RO: a reduce-only order.
- **Qty, Filled**: contracts ordered and filled.
- **Limit, Avg**: the limit and the fills' average price, USDT, to the leg's tick.
- **Fee**: USDT paid, a cost shown as a positive amount (as in Summary); Pending while the venue has not reported it.
- **Latency**: sent → final state in hand, ms, this host's clock (paper: the configured simulation).
- **Status**: Filled, Partial, No Fill (an IOC that met nothing), Rejected (with the venue's code), Working, Unknown (being queried).
- **Limit of a run**: the lowest–highest limit of its orders; a run has no latency.

WITH z AS MATERIALIZED (WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms

rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel), ko AS (

  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT o.live, o.cycle_id FROM trade.cex_order o WHERE o.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND o.cycle_id = '$cycle') oc
  JOIN trade.decision k ON k.live = oc.live AND k.cycle_id = oc.cycle_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT k.detail ->> 'client_order_id' AS id
    UNION ALL SELECT e #>> '{}' FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(k.detail -> 'client_order_ids') = 'array' THEN k.detail -> 'client_order_ids' END) e

  WHEN k.kind = 'entry' AND k.thin THEN 'Thin Leg' WHEN k.kind = 'entry' THEN 'Entry'
  WHEN k.kind = 'pair' THEN CASE k.action WHEN 'send_thick' THEN 'Pair' WHEN 'send_thin' THEN 'Top-Up' WHEN 'close_thin' THEN 'Profit Close'
                                          WHEN 'unwind' THEN 'Unwind' ELSE initcap(replace(k.action, '_', ' ')) END
  WHEN k.kind = 'exit' THEN CASE k.line WHEN 'exit1' THEN 'Exit 1' WHEN 'exit2' THEN 'Exit 2' ELSE 'Exit' END || CASE WHEN k.thin THEN ' · Thin' ELSE '' END

  ELSE initcap(replace(coalesce(k.kind, o.purpose), '_', ' ')) END AS "Step", CASE o.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END AS "Leg",

  WHEN k.kind = 'entry' AND k.thin THEN 'Thin Leg' WHEN k.kind = 'entry' THEN 'Entry'
  WHEN k.kind = 'pair' THEN CASE k.action WHEN 'send_thick' THEN 'Pair' WHEN 'send_thin' THEN 'Top-Up' WHEN 'close_thin' THEN 'Profit Close'
                                          WHEN 'unwind' THEN 'Unwind' ELSE initcap(replace(k.action, '_', ' ')) END
  WHEN k.kind = 'exit' THEN CASE k.line WHEN 'exit1' THEN 'Exit 1' WHEN 'exit2' THEN 'Exit 2' ELSE 'Exit' END || CASE WHEN k.thin THEN ' · Thin' ELSE '' END
  WHEN k.kind = 'exit_pair' THEN CASE k.line WHEN 'exit1' THEN 'Exit 1' WHEN 'exit2' THEN 'Exit 2' ELSE 'Exit' END || CASE k.action WHEN 'hard_close' THEN ' · Hard Close' ELSE ' · Thick' END
  ELSE initcap(replace(coalesce(k.kind, o.purpose), '_', ' ')) END) END AS fold, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY o.submitted_ms, o.client_order_id) AS n
  FROM trade.cex_order o
LEFT JOIN ko k ON k.id = o.client_order_id
LEFT JOIN trade.lot l ON l.live = o.live AND l.lot_id = o.lot_id
WHERE o.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND o.cycle_id = '$cycle'),
g AS (SELECT r.n, sum(r.st) OVER (ORDER BY r.n) AS grp FROM (
        SELECT r.n, CASE WHEN r.fold IS NOT NULL AND r.fold = lag(r.fold) OVER (ORDER BY r.n) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS st FROM r) r),

FROM a JOIN r o ON o.n = a.n0 ORDER BY a.n0)

panels.title: Positions Now · ct, USDT and Bps
panels.description:
Each leg at the Run's newest inventory sample (every 10 s), whatever the Range; the venue's figures live only (the paper venue reports positions alone).

- **Venue, Ledger**: the venue's position and the program's ledger (dust included), contracts, signed (+ long, − short); they must match.
- **Mark, Liq Price**: the venue's mark and liquidation price, USDT.
- **Liq Distance**: the liquidation price from the mark, in % of the mark: amber within 25 %, red within 10 %.
- **Venue UPL**: the venue's unrealised P&L of the leg, USDT.
- **Exposure**: the position at the newest second's mid, USDT, signed.
- **Funding**: the newest settled funding rate × 10⁴ (bps of the position's value per settlement), as Bitget publishes it: + longs pay shorts.
- **Age**: seconds since the sample while the Run runs; amber past a minute.

targets.rawSql:
WITH z AS MATERIALIZED (WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms

panels.title: Batch Ends · USDT and s
panels.description:
How the Run's entry batches opened in the Range ended (4.4, core/SPEC.md 12.4; one batch is one lot).

- **Batch End**: Built, Built Partial, Unwound at a Profit or at the Stop, Entry Failed (the thin leg filled nothing); a Run trading both legs together: Built, Unwound (a leg filled and was trimmed back), No Fill.
- **Net**: the lots' own net, USDT: of a void lot what its unwind or profit close made; an open lot's is not in it.
- **Pairing s**: the median time from the thin leg's first fill to the end of the pairing, seconds (thin leg first only).

targets.rawSql:
WITH z AS MATERIALIZED (WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel)
SELECT CASE coalesce(to_jsonb(l) ->> 'end_state', CASE l.status WHEN 'void' THEN coalesce(l.void_reason, 'no_fill') WHEN 'building' THEN 'building' ELSE 'built' END) WHEN 'built' THEN 'Built' WHEN 'built_partial' THEN 'Built Partial' WHEN 'unwound_profit' THEN 'Unwound at a Profit' WHEN 'unwound_stop' THEN 'Unwound at the Stop' WHEN 'one_leg' THEN 'Unwound: One Leg Trimmed Back' WHEN 'entry_failed' THEN 'Entry Failed' WHEN 'no_fill' THEN 'No Fill' WHEN 'building' THEN 'Pairing Now' WHEN 'store_error' THEN 'Not Recorded' ELSE initcap(replace(coalesce(to_jsonb(l) ->> 'end_state', CASE l.status WHEN 'void' THEN coalesce(l.void_reason, 'no_fill') WHEN 'building' THEN 'building' ELSE 'built' END), '_', ' ')) END AS "Batch End", count(*) AS "Batches", sum(l.net) FILTER (WHERE l.status IN ('closed', 'void')) AS "Net",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.ms) / 1000.0 AS "Pairing s"
FROM trade.lot l
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(f.ts_ms) FILTER (WHERE f.detail ->> 'action' = 'done') - min((f.detail ->> 'first_fill_ms')::bigint) AS ms
                   FROM trade.decision f WHERE f.live = l.live AND f.lot_id = l.lot_id AND f.kind = 'pair') p ON true
WHERE l.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND l.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND l.opened_ms >= (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg) AND l.opened_ms < (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(CASE coalesce(to_jsonb(l) ->> 'end_state', CASE l.status WHEN 'void' THEN coalesce(l.void_reason, 'no_fill') WHEN 'building' THEN 'building' ELSE 'built' END) WHEN 'built' THEN 0 WHEN 'built_partial' THEN 1 WHEN 'unwound_profit' THEN 2 WHEN 'unwound_stop' THEN 3 WHEN 'one_leg' THEN 4 WHEN 'entry_failed' THEN 5 WHEN 'no_fill' THEN 6 WHEN 'building' THEN 7 WHEN 'store_error' THEN 8 ELSE 99 END), 1)

panels.title: Order Latency by Stage · ms
panels.description:
Each stage over the Run's orders submitted in the Range; paper: the configured simulated latency, not a measurement.

- **Clock**: local: this host's clock; venue: Bitget's.
- **Orders**: orders measured.
- **Median, P90, Max**: the median, 90th percentile and largest, ms.

targets.rawSql:
WITH z AS MATERIALIZED (WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel)

SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((r.started_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') || '–' || CASE WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NULL THEN 'now' WHEN to_char(to_timestamp((r.started_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD') = to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD') THEN to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') ELSE to_char(to_timestamp((r.stopped_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') END || ' · Bitget · ' || replace(coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS'), ' / ', '/') || ' · ' || CASE WHEN r.live THEN 'Live' ELSE 'Paper' END || CASE WHEN r.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) THEN ' · shown' ELSE '' END AS "Run", to_timestamp(r.started_ms / 1000.0) AS "Started",

       (r.config #>> '{inventory,capital}')::numeric * (r.config #>> '{inventory,leverage}')::numeric AS "N",
       r.host AS "Host", r.run_id AS "Run ID", r.started_ms::text AS from_ms, coalesce(r.stopped_ms::text, 'now') AS to_ms
FROM trade.process_run r
ORDER BY r.started_ms DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Funding Records · USDT
panels.description:
Each funding record of the Run's two contracts settled in the Range, and each settlement a finished round trip still waits for.

- **Status**: Booked (to the round trip whose interval holds the settlement) or Awaited (amber).
- **Amount**: + received.
- **Execution ID**: the round trip it is booked to, by its opening time (UTC+8).

targets.rawSql:
WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms
                         FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'),
rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT to_timestamp(f.settlement_ms / 1000.0) AS "Settlement", f.symbol AS "Contract", 'Booked' AS "Status", f.amount AS "Amount",
         (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((x.opened_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM trade.cycle x WHERE x.live = f.live AND x.cycle_id = f.cycle_id) AS "Execution ID"
  FROM trade.funding f WHERE f.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND f.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND f.settlement_ms >= (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg) AND f.settlement_ms < (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_timestamp((a ->> 'settlement_ms')::bigint / 1000.0), CASE a ->> 'leg' WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END, 'Awaited', NULL,
         to_char(to_timestamp((c.opened_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI:SS')
  FROM trade.cycle c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(c.funding_awaited) a
  WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array') t
UNION ALL

WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.funding f WHERE f.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND f.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND f.settlement_ms >= (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg) AND f.settlement_ms < (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND (c.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) OR c.cycle_id IN (SELECT dr.cycle_id FROM trade.decision dr WHERE dr.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND dr.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND dr.cycle_id IS NOT NULL)) AND jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(c.funding_awaited) > 0)

WITH sel AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.run_id, r.live, r.started_ms, r.stopped_ms, r.host, r.config, coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS end_ms FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT CASE '$run' WHEN '__live' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN '__paper' THEN (SELECT x.run_id FROM trade.process_run x WHERE NOT x.live ORDER BY x.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE '$run' END) AND coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bull,ticker}', 'SOXL') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.config #>> '{cex,pair,bear,ticker}', 'SOXS') = '$combo'), rg AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT greatest(sel.started_ms, (CASE WHEN '${since}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${since}' <> '0' THEN '${since}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${since_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${since_hour}'::int ELSE 0 END * 3600000 ELSE 0 END)) AS from_ms, least(sel.end_ms + 1, (CASE WHEN '${until}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,14}$' AND '${until}'::bigint < 99999999999999 THEN '${until}'::bigint + CASE WHEN '${until_hour}' ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$' THEN '${until_hour}'::int ELSE 24 END * 3600000 ELSE 99999999999999 END)) AS to_ms FROM sel) SELECT x.ts_ms AS time, 'Anchor change · ' || CASE WHEN x.anchor_kind IS NULL THEN 'no anchor (Missing): no entries until one is read' WHEN x.ps IS DISTINCT FROM x.session_id THEN 'new session ' || x.session_id || ' (the close)
bell anchor (F × Binance''s index at the close; the NAV to follow)' WHEN x.pk IS NULL THEN 'an anchor read again' WHEN x.pk = 'bell' AND x.anchor_kind = 'nav' THEN 'NAV confirmed for session ' || x.session_id || '
both legs'' NAV unchanged for 1 h (Direxion' || coalesce(': first seen ' || (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((min(a.known_ms)) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'nav_seen' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) || ', confirmed ' || (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((max(a.known_ms)) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'nav' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms), '') || ')' WHEN x.pk = 'nav' AND x.anchor_kind = 'bell' THEN 'the bell again: the NAV no longer confirmed' WHEN (SELECT string_agg(CASE a.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END || ' ' || trim_scale(a.value), ', ') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'dividend' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) IS NOT NULL THEN 'a dividend takes effect (anchor less the dividend; read for the session: ' || (SELECT string_agg(CASE a.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END || ' ' || trim_scale(a.value), ', ') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'dividend' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) || ' USD)' ELSE 'a split, or a corrected reading, of the same kind' END || '
' || '$bull ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bull, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bull, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USD · ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bull / x.pf, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bull / x.f, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USDT
' || '$bear ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bear, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bear, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USD · ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bear / x.pf, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bear / x.f, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USDT
USDT = USD ÷ F, F = ' || CASE WHEN x.pf = x.f THEN x.f::text ELSE coalesce(x.pf::text, '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(x.f::text, '–') END || ' USD/USDT (the program''s)' AS text FROM (SELECT s.ts_ms, s.session_id, s.anchor_kind, s.anchor_bull, s.anchor_bear, s.f, lag(s.ts_ms) OVER w AS pts, lag(s.session_id) OVER w AS ps, lag(s.anchor_kind) OVER w AS pk, lag(s.anchor_bull) OVER w AS p_bull, lag(s.anchor_bear) OVER w AS p_bear, lag(s.f) OVER w AS pf FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.ts_ms >= greatest($__from, (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg)) - 600000 AND s.ts_ms <= least($__to, (SELECT rg.to_ms FROM rg) - 1) AND s.run_id = (SELECT sel.run_id FROM sel) AND s.live = (SELECT sel.live FROM sel) WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY s.ts_ms)) x WHERE x.ts_ms >= greatest($__from, (SELECT rg.from_ms FROM rg)) AND x.pts IS NOT NULL AND (x.anchor_kind, x.anchor_bull, x.anchor_bear) IS DISTINCT FROM (x.pk, x.p_bull, x.p_bear)
